The use of noise abatement barriers would cause significant visual and aesthetic disruption to the existing and proposed land use of the area. Therefore, the effects of any noise abatement measures are considered not be economically reasonable nor aesthetically acceptable for the properties that do not have access to Lincoln Highway.
4. The commercial establishments are generally located at or in the immediate vicinity of intersections being served by both the proposed improvement and the intersecting traffic. It is to be noted that as additional fully access-controlled facilities are built that the commercial trips on Lincoln Highway destined for areas outside of the Bloom and Rich Township environs would be diverted to the more appropriate facilities. Therefore, the predicted noise level for these commercial establishments are probably higher than what will actually occur.
In accordance with PPM 90-2, Section 5,a. (5) entitled "Coordination with Local Officials on Undeveloped Lands", and definitions contained in Appendix "A", the Illinois Department of Transportation, District One Office will transmit approximate generalized future noise levels for various distances from the highway improvement for undeveloped lands to the responsible control for zoning. The local agencies having responsible control for zoning within the limits of this improvement are (1) Cook County-Department of Building Zoning and Planning, (2) City of Chicago Heights, (3) Village of Matteson, (4) Village of Olympia Fields, and (5) Village of Park Forest.
At the present time, it is not considered feasible and prudent in the best overall economic and public interest of the communities involved to apply structure—noise abatement measures to meet the design year L10 traffic generated noise level standards for land uses along the proposed improvement. Any structural noise abatement measure would disrupt the land access ingress and egress movements for businesses, commercial properties, industrial properties and residential properties along the alignment.
